title: rhinanthus major subsp. glaber
intro: Rhinanthus major subsp. glaber, commonly known as Yellow Rattle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Orobanchaceae family. It is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains some of its nutrients by tapping into the roots of neighboring plants. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including respiratory problems and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of Rhinanthus major subsp. glaber include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
